solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Disclose porter's cunning on board ship

indicators.note: the porter has his cunning on board with him, read as carried along just ahead of him in the line

parts.note: to air something is to make it public
craft as artful cleverness
a porter carries things; the 's means 'has'

explanation.surface: Someone reveals that a porter is up to something sly aboard a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' reads as the porter carrying his cunning along with him, so the cunning comes just ahead of the porter rather than inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft carrier is a large naval vessel that serves as a floating airfield.

clue.text: Some pills worker and I push down soldiers

parts.note: the worker ant is the crossword's standard worker
taken as written
to depress is to press downwards
soldier ants, a caste of the insect

explanation.surface: A list of pills, a labourer and a press-down instruction, then troops — reads like a drug run by an army.
explanation.definitionFit: Antidepressants are medicines, often tablets, prescribed for depression.

clue.text: City developer rebuilt our slum

indicators.note: something rebuilt is put together again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A property developer has redeveloped a run-down district.
explanation.definitionFit: In legend Romulus founded Rome, so he is the developer of a famous city.

clue.text: Republican nation includes English ballad in event

indicators.note: the combined word takes the following words into itself, just after its opening letter

parts.note: R is the standard abbreviation for Republican
a race as a people or nation
E is the abbreviation for English
a lay is a short narrative poem or song

explanation.surface: A Republican state has an English folk song in some ceremony.
explanation.walkthrough: The Republican and the nation join first; the English ballad then slips in straight after that opening letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A relay race is a sporting event in which team members run successive legs.

clue.text: Cardinal writing to welcome rector

indicators.note: to welcome a guest is to take them in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: fist is an informal word for handwriting
R is the abbreviation for rector

explanation.surface: A Catholic cardinal writes to greet a parish priest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cardinal' looks like a churchman beside 'rector', but here it is the adjective meaning chief. Fist is old slang for handwriting.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinal means principal or foremost, and first likewise means chief or most important.

clue.text: Excited man gets a bear back

parts.note: cock is a familiar British address for a man, as in 'old cock'
taken as written

indicators.note: going back means the bear's name is read from right to left

parts.note: Winnie-the-Pooh, the famous bear

explanation.surface: A thrilled man has a bear returned to him.
explanation.definitionFit: Cock-a-hoop means jubilant and elated, as an excited person is.

clue.text: Birds I raised in Yemeni capital

indicators.note: in a down entry, raising a letter moves it higher, so it is set in earlier among the others

parts.note: rails are wading birds
taken as written; it is lifted from its place in the birds

explanation.surface: Someone raised some birds while living in the capital of Yemen.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the I out of RAILS and put it one place higher, which in a down light means earlier. 'Capital' is money, not a city.
explanation.definitionFit: The rial is the currency unit of Yemen, so rials are Yemeni money.

clue.text: Popular time to welcome the return of mating sloth

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular

indicators.note: welcoming someone takes them inside, so one piece goes into another

parts.note: an era is a period of time

indicators.note: a return goes back the way it came, so the word for mating runs backwards

parts.note: it is slang for sex

explanation.surface: A mating season returns for the sloths, a fashionable moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It' is a long-standing euphemism for sex. 'Sloth' looks like the animal but means idleness.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloth means laziness, and inertia is a reluctance to move or act.

clue.text: Having a hunch game's supported

parts.note: a round of golf is a game; the 's stands for 'is'
to shoulder a load is to bear it up

explanation.surface: A gambler with a hunch thinks the game is backed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having a hunch' looks like a gut feeling but means a stoop.
explanation.definitionFit: Round-shouldered describes a stooping posture with hunched shoulders.

clue.text: Master butler smashed a glass

indicators.note: something smashed is broken into bits, so these letters are reassembled differently

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for master, as in an MA
taken as written

explanation.surface: The lord of the house's butler has broken a glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A tumbler is a flat-bottomed drinking glass without a stem.

clue.text: Drinks brewed by superior French wine producer

parts.note: cha and tea, two names for the same brewed drink
U means upper-class, superior

explanation.surface: A posh French vintner makes brewed drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: Cha is a British slang word for tea, so both drinks are brewed.
explanation.definitionFit: In Bordeaux a chateau is an estate that makes its own wine.

clue.text: Have an affair with duke's partner

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for duke
an ally is a partner

explanation.surface: Someone is told to take a duke's wife or husband as a lover.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is read as 'has', joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To dally with someone is to flirt or have a casual romance with them.

clue.text: Passed through East Germany following a van?

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the region's letters go after the vehicle

parts.note: the Ford Transit is a common British van, hence the question mark
E is the abbreviation for east
D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: A van travelled through the former East Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: 'East Germany' looks like the GDR but splits into two abbreviations.
explanation.definitionFit: To transit a place is to travel across it, so transited means passed through.

clue.text: Light green potash ICI manufactured

indicators.note: things manufactured are made up from raw material, so these letters are reworked

parts.note: ICI is the chemical company, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A chemical firm, ICI (once Britain's biggest), produced a pale green potash.
explanation.definitionFit: Pistachio is a pale yellowish-green shade named after the nut.

clue.text: Riff-raff stop independent institute holding vote over opposition leader

indicators.note: to hold something is to keep it inside, so other letters sit within

parts.note: ho is an old call to halt
I is the abbreviation for independent
a poll is a vote

indicators.note: a leader is at the front, so only the opening letter of the word is used

parts.note: the first letter of opposition
I is the abbreviation for institute

explanation.surface: Let an independent think tank, holding a ballot over who leads the opposition, keep out the rabble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Independent institute' gives two single-letter abbreviations that wrap around the vote and the leader. 'Ho' is an old call to halt.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoi polloi, Greek for 'the many', is a disdainful term for the common people.

clue.text: Plot involving Wimbledon champion, it's said

indicators.note: something said is spoken, so the champion's name counts only by its sound

parts.note: Steffi Graf won Wimbledon seven times

explanation.surface: A conspiracy involving a tennis winner at Wimbledon is rumoured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plot' looks like a scheme but is the verb meaning to chart.
explanation.definitionFit: To plot points is to mark them on a chart, which is to graph them.

clue.text: Attendant embroidered monograms

indicators.note: embroidered thread is worked into a new pattern, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A servant wears stitched initials on his uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: A groomsman is a male attendant of the bridegroom at a wedding.

clue.text: European Economic Community workers return leaving behind new anchor

indicators.note: returning means going back, so the combined letters are read from the end

parts.note: the old initials of the European Economic Community

indicators.note: what is left behind is dropped, so one letter goes

parts.note: men as workers, a workforce
N is the abbreviation for new; this letter is removed

explanation.surface: Common Market labourers come home, leaving a fresh anchor behind.
explanation.walkthrough: EEC + MEN reversed gives NEMCEE; dropping the N leaves the answer. An anchor here is a presenter, not a ship's weight.
explanation.definitionFit: An emcee (MC) is a master of ceremonies or host, as a television anchor is.

clue.text: Church Latin exam's hypnotic

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for church
L is the abbreviation for Latin
an oral is a spoken exam; the 's means 'is'

explanation.surface: A church Latin test is mesmerising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hypnotic' looks like an adjective but is a noun: a sleep-inducing drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Chloral hydrate is a sedative drug, a hypnotic in the medical sense of sleep-inducing.

clue.text: I am quick texting you off the cuff

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am
prompt means quick to act
U is how 'you' is shortened in text messages, signalled by texting

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of being fast at sending text messages without preparing.
explanation.definitionFit: Impromptu means done without preparation, just as something said off the cuff is.

clue.text: Pavarotti dropping bible off for loyalist

indicators.note: off as in gone wrong, so the remaining letters are jumbled
dropping something lets it fall away, so those letters leave the name

parts.note: the tenor's name, taken letter for letter
AV is the Authorised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: Pavarotti drops off a Bible for a devoted supporter.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove AV from the name to leave PAROTTI, then rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A patriot is loyal to their country, so a loyalist is a fair synonym.

clue.text: Extreme problems as Spurs play football without wingers

definitions.note: plural definition for a singular answer, treating it as a condition

indicators.note: with the wingers gone, the outer letters of the phrase fall away and only the inside is kept

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word, the next, and the start of the last

explanation.surface: Tottenham Hotspur play football without their wide men, causing big problems.
explanation.walkthrough: Spurs is the nickname of Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club. 'Extreme' refers to the extremities: problems of the feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Splayfoot is a condition of flat, outward-turned feet, a problem with an extremity of the body.

clue.text: Brute's shout of joy

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a coarse, brutish person, after the beast-men in Gulliver's Travels
second meaning: a whoop of delight

explanation.surface: A brute lets out a cry of delight.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both Swift's savage humanoids and an exclamation of excitement.

clue.text: Disorder hit my glands

indicators.note: disorder means a lack of order, so these letters are thrown into a new sequence

parts.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A medical condition has struck someone's glands.
explanation.definitionFit: Thymi is the plural of thymus, a gland in the chest.

clue.text: Quiet man pursues tailless dog

indicators.note: without a tail, the word loses its final letter
pursuing means following behind, so the man comes after the dog

parts.note: a mutt is a mongrel dog
Ed is a man's name

explanation.surface: A silent man chases a dog with no tail.
explanation.definitionFit: Muted means softened or hushed, so quiet is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Raced back with old Prince to find aquatic mammal

indicators.note: going back means the verb is read from right to left

parts.note: ran is the past tense of run, to race
W is the abbreviation for with
Prince Hal, the young Henry V in Shakespeare's Henry IV

explanation.surface: Someone raced back with a prince of old to spot a sea creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The narwhal is an Arctic whale with a long spiral tusk, a mammal living in water.

clue.text: Oddly your mum is regularly merry and more delectable

indicators.note: oddly means taking the letters in odd-numbered positions of the next few words

parts.note: first and third letters

indicators.note: regularly means taking letters at even intervals, here every second one

parts.note: first and third letters
first letter
second and fourth letters

explanation.surface: Strangely, your mother is often cheerful and tastier.
explanation.definitionFit: Yummier, the comparative of yummy, means tastier, so more delectable.

clue.text: Defines optional version as 'bloody-minded'

indicators.note: a version is a different rendering of something, so the letters are recast

parts.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A dictionary entry glosses an alternative wording as stubborn.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-opinionated person stubbornly insists on their own views, as a bloody-minded one does.
